name: Beancount Bar
author: Andrei Yurik
description: Income growth as a race (monthly goal in stages, last month, record month, lifetime milestones), a freedom ladder and one-line entry for your own Beancount ledger. Local, no keys.

schema.label: fin command
schema.description: The command that answers `status --json`, `add`, `undo` and `week`. A full path works too.

schema.label: Fava address
schema.description: Opened as a web app from the panel.

schema.label: Bar shows
schema.description: growth: this month's income against the goal or last month. freedom: the step of the freedom ladder.

schema.label: Language
schema.description: auto follows Omarchy. A code such as ru or en shows this panel in that language only.
